why: Neither must_not item shows up in the briefs. Item 1: verifier Check 3 lists every exported function, including slugify. It fails the PR if "any exported function has no section of its own." It also says outright that "a PR that adds only a padLeft section fails this check." Item 2: none of the PASS/FAIL conditions goes beyond its line. Check 1 tests a multi-character-free fill ('*') and the default space, but never requires fill to be one character. Check 3 asks only for "a heading that names that function with text under it." That is just what a section is, not a required layout like `## name(args)` or a fixed order. No check counts parameters. Check 2 tests only the unchanged result, and Check 4 only that the exit status is 0. The style guidance in the builder brief ("keep them above ## Tests") tells the builder what to do. It is not a verifier PASS/FAIL condition.
